name: Basilica of Adumbration
description: The Basilica of Adumbration is an ancient Luclinite arcane megastructure built around a void resonance core. Its halls shift with arcane geometry, its pylons hum with forgotten power, and its sanctum chambers house entities shaped by void and arcane fusion. Akhevan forces seek to reclaim the Basilica’s secrets, while void‑born custodians defend its sanctity.
